analyst_observations: Frontmatter repair (eval 0) is a tie — both achieve 6/6. However the skill uses standard taxonomy (doc_type: concept, type/concept) while baseline invents non-standard values (doc_type: chapter-notes, type/chapter-notes).

Orphan processing (eval 1) is the biggest differentiator: skill produces formal callouts and full enhanced frontmatter, baseline does not. The skill's one failure (links_to_existing_vault) is borderline — found 1 of 2 required vault links.
Audit report (eval 2) is a tie at 3/3 for both. The baseline was actually more thorough (124 headings vs 64, found 200+ broken links vs skill's focused 4), but both met all assertions.
Timing is nearly identical across all evals (~280-380s). The skill doesn't add overhead.
The qualitative difference is in taxonomy compliance — the skill produces output matching the vault-ingest standard, while the baseline improvises its own schema.
